# Computer Modern math outlines

Source: https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/amsfonts/pfb/ (AMSFonts 3.04).

The unmodified cmmi12.pfb, cmr12.pfb and cmsy10.pfb files are distributed under
SIL OFL 1.1; see OFL.txt. Copyright 1997, 2009 American Mathematical Society.

`glyphs.json` contains SVG outline/metric data generated by
`python3 scripts/build-cm-math.py` (requires fonttools), with the original font
names retained in the unmodified sources. The generated glyph table is named
for its MathJax target tables, not as a replacement font using a reserved name.

The PDF renderer uses these outlines for ordinary mathematical letters,
numbers and symbols, at 12 TeX points, matching the supplied C8 reference.
MathJax retains its TeX vector glyphs for other variants and large operators.
